description: Invisible hand attachment sockets for optional props carried by CH Character Studio actors.

heldObject.gripAnchor: pixel coordinate inside the held-object source image
heldObject.offset: additional integer [x,y] offset after socket alignment

rules: Sockets exist in every idle and walk frame even when no object is active.
An inactive socket renders no pixels and does not change the actor silhouette.
Held objects follow approved hand landmarks and never modify actor locomotion.
Visual and color-mask images use exactly the same socket, grip-anchor, offset and depth transform.
If an object has no authored mask, opaque visual pixels default to held_object.R (object_primary).
Socket debug markers are editor-only and must never be exported into runtime art.
